haunt_energy.regeneration_turn_based: 1 at the start of each ghost phase
haunt_energy.anti_spam: Repeated identical haunts on the same target or room receive temporary resistance.

actions.effect: Set off an already armed built-in or Trap-deck trap when a legal trigger exists.
Draw the top Trap card and place it on a server-approved tile in the current or adjacent connected room.
Raise or lower a monster's interest in a legal room, noise source, scent trail, patrol point, or target category.
Request one legal monster movement toward an adjacent square or connected room during the next monster phase.
Close, bar, rattle, or briefly lock one hauntable door with an available counterplay.
Alter one room's lighting for a short duration.
Move or animate a hauntable prop to create noise, distraction, cover, or a visual cue without fabricating evidence.
Create a directional warning, false trail, intimidation cue, or atmospheric effect.
Reveal a trap outline briefly, distract a monster, or extend a rescue window without revealing private cards.
Temporarily control an authored armor suit, statue, chandelier, bell, mirror, or ritual anchor.
